title: Desert Sovereign
description: A mysterious robed figure stands in a barren desert under a massive red sun. The figure wears an ornate golden crown, a flowing sheer veil, and a robe decorated with glowing concentric circles, while holding a tall staff topped with a glowing lantern.
prompt: A regal figure in flowing orange and blue robes with glowing concentric circle patterns stands in a sandy desert, wearing an ornate golden crown and sheer starry veil that billows in the wind. The figure holds a tall dark staff topped with a glowing ornate lantern. A giant red sun dominates the dramatic orange sky above endless dunes, with concentric circles drawn in the sand around the figure's feet.
